window_note: Flight 15 complete. No official SpaceX Flight 16 window. FAA planning target NET 10 Dec 2026; trade press cites late Jan 2027 (unconfirmed). Expected Starlink mission with B-23/S-43.

items.title: Flight 15 launch and recovery
items.detail: Liftoff 22:47:36 UTC from Pad 2. Ship 42 caught at tower. Booster 22 catch aborted offshore.

items.title: Ship 43 engine installation
items.detail: Receiving engines in Mega Bay 2 (NSF Starship Update, 26 Nov). No static fire yet.

items.title: Booster 23 pad campaign
items.detail: Still in Mega Bay 1; last cryo 15 Oct 2026; 0 static fires. Unconfirmed: Pad 2 prep for rollout and static fire early Dec 2026.

items.title: Pad selection
items.detail: Starbase Pad 2 or LC-39A — unconfirmed (NSF 19–20 Nov, FCC filing in secondary reporting). LC-39A nearly complete, in acceptance testing.

items.title: Flight 16 schedule
items.detail: No official SpaceX date. FAA planning NET 10 Dec 2026; trade press late Jan 2027 estimates unconfirmed.
